option: Station-conditioned acquisition-shift identification with paired multi-instrument views
rationale: Uses the archive's rare repeated-master structure; within-station metadata baseline is near chance; strict unseen-instrument plus unseen-master evaluation is possible for 13 adequately supported station/instrument domains

option: Classical within-station closed-set classification with master aggregation
rationale: Immediately feasible and strong but less novel; must distinguish single-spectrum from multi-view master performance
Only clean station-transfer comparison because both chemicals occur in pills and surfaces; just 26 masters limits precision

option: Paired-view supervised contrastive or domain-adversarial representation
rationale: Well matched to repeated instruments per master but needs careful positives so same-chemical masters are not incorrectly treated as negatives
High scores are partly attributable to station chemistry coupling; useful as a continuity baseline not the main scientific claim
Only seven classes and held-out chemicals are often held-out stations; unknown rejection cannot be cleanly separated from domain detection
Can produce an anomaly score but lacks a sufficiently diverse external unknown set for strong validation

option: Disentangled VAE denoising and nuisance removal
rationale: No clean target spectra paired with corruption; nuisance factors are incompletely crossed; latent-factor semantics are not identifiable

option: Large end-to-end CNN or Transformer from scratch
rationale: Only 69 independent masters; bounded CNN already trails classical models and has much higher fold variance
